k: When Pip is a Kid, he gets a wobbly tooth. Wibbly! One day it might come out while he has a snack. It goes under his pillow, so put him to bed and see what happ

t: Why does Pip ask how I am?
k: The first time you see Pip each day, he asks how you are. Tap a face, or Not now. If you feel sad or cross, he gives you a hug and can breathe slowly with you.

t: What is the little face by the coins?
k: It shows how Pip feels. Tap it and he tells you why, like when he is hungry or bored.
Food, fun, energy, clean, health and manners. Keep them up and Pip stays happy. If health gets low, Pip is in danger!
Something is low: look at the bars. Feed him, play with him, clean up, or put him to bed.
Pip needs you. If you leave him too long it counts as a care mistake.
Tap Feed, then Meal or Snack. Snacks are fun, but too many make him chubby.
He goes pink when he's embarrassed or loved, red when he's cross, green when he feels poorly, blue when he's cold, and gold when you earn a title!
Tap Clean when you see a mess. He gets washed and sparkles.
Only scold Pip when he is being naughty: he says sorry and learns manners. Scolding him for nothing makes him cross!

t: Pip is ill. What do I do?
k: Tap Medicine. Keeping him clean helps him stay well.

t: Why does Pip give me tips?
k: When you start, Pip tells you what to do the first time he needs something: feeding, playing, cleaning and more. Each tip comes once.

t: What happens when Pip gets old?
k: When Pip has been with you a long time, he becomes a wise old Pip: grey eyebrows, glasses some of the time, a walking stick, and lots of stories about the old d
Baby, Kid, then Grown-up. How well you look after him decides what kind of Pip he grows into. Look after him really well and he might get a pet of his own!

t: What does Pip do when the game is shut?
k: He gets hungry and bored, so come back and look after him! Come back after an hour and a page tells you what he got up to while you were away. The longer you ar
Every pet you meet is kept for ever, even after a new egg. Choose who is out with Pip in Settings > Pet. Look after Pip well and you will meet more!

t: What do the pet colours and stars mean?
k: Pets come in five kinds: Common ★ (grey), Magic ★★ (blue), Rare ★★★ (gold), Epic ★★★★ (purple) and Legendary ★★★★★ (orange). The more stars, the harder they are

t: Why did another pet come to visit?
k: Pets you've met drop in now and then to say hi! Choose who lives with Pip in Settings > Pet.
When a Pip passes away, his score goes in the Top 5. Then a new egg arrives.

t: What are the twinkling stars at night?
k: Some evenings, when you turn the light off before 9 o'clock, stars twinkle in Pip's sky. Tap the glowing star, then the next, to join them into a picture. It st

t: Can I rock Pip to sleep?
k: Yes! While he's asleep, tilt the phone gently from side to side and he sways in his cot. Keep going and he hums himself to sleep. It doesn't happen in Calm mode

t: What is the best bit of today?
k: Some nights, when you turn his light off, Pip asks what the best bit of your day was. Tap a picture and he says something kind. It goes in his diary.

t: Can I turn the lava lamp off?
k: Yes! Shop > Room > Bedtime: tap the lava lamp to put it away, and tap it again to bring it back. It only glows when no room item is out.
Tap Sleep to put him to bed, then Lights to turn the light off. Lights off between 7 and 9 in the evening, left off till morning, earns coins and a sleep streak
He dreams about his day, talks in his sleep, blows snore bubbles (tap one to pop it!) and sometimes counts sheep. Tap him to tuck him in. With the light off, lo

t: Can Pip have a bedtime story?
k: Sometimes when you put him to bed he asks for one. Tap Story and pick how the story goes!

t: What are the glow stars and the music box?
k: Bedtime things from the shop (Room tab). They work alongside your room item: the stars glow when the light is off, and the music box plays a little tune as he d

t: Can Pip see the real Moon?
k: Yes! When the lights are off, the Moon in his night sky is tonight's real Moon, and it moves across the sky through the night. Some nights there's no Moon at al

t: Why is the screen dimmer late at night?
k: After 9 at night Pip gets sleepy: the screen goes a little darker, he yawns more, and he might ask if it's your bedtime too. It all goes back to normal in the m

t: How does the talent show work?
k: Book > Tricks > Talent show! Pip does his tricks for three animal judges, and they hold up their scores. The more tricks you've taught him, the more stars

t: Can I draw a picture for Pip?
k: Play > Toys > Draw. Draw anything on the grid, then tap Hang it up! Pip puts it on his wall. Your last few drawings are in the book (Memories).
Fishing is one of the games in Play. Tap Reel in! when the float dips. Every fish goes back in the water, and each one is worth a coin. Sometimes you fish out r

t: How do I brush my teeth with Pip?
k: Play > Toys > Brush. Brush for 2 minutes while Pip brushes too. He tells you which teeth to do next, and at the end he has a sparkly grin.

t: Can I play hide and seek with Pip?
k: Sometimes Pip says Hide and seek! Close your eyes, then hides behind something. Look for his tuft or his feet poking out, and tap where he is.

t: How do I play Pip says?
k: Only do the move when Pip says "Pip says" first! If he just says "Jump!", don't tap anything. Two mistakes and the game is over.

t: How does the secret code game work?
k: Pip's message is in secret code: every letter has slid along the alphabet. Tap ◀ or ▶ to slide them all back until the word makes sense, then tap That's it! Lik

t: Does Pip play old arcade games?
k: Yes! Look out for marching invaders, dots to chomp, a wall of bricks, barrels to jump, a giant burger and lots more. And when THE FLOOR IS LAVA, he needs a chai
Lost a game? Sometimes a countdown starts. Tap Play before it gets to 0 to have another go at the same game straight away. It never costs coins.

t: Why does Pip turn into a cube?
k: He loves cube jumping games! Sometimes he plays a level, has lots of goes, flies through portals or builds his own level. Watch for a secret coin.

t: Can Pip visit the other Pip games?
k: Yes! Settings > Pip's games. Tap a game and a grown-up answers a sum, then that game opens with your Pip in it: his look, his name and his hat. Play a bit wi

t: How do I play with Pip?
k: Tap Play, then Game for a mini-game, Toys for something to play with, or Pet to play with his pet (once he has one). Winning a game cheers him up.
Play > Toys. Make beats, play freeze dance (tap Freeze! to stop Pip mid-dance), breathe slowly with Pip when you feel wound up, or brush your teeth with him.
Yes! Press and hold on Pip and he squishes flat like a squishy toy. Let go and he boings back.

t: How do I play Match the card?
k: Play a card with the same shape or the same number as the one on the pile. Draw gives you new cards. A +4 matches anything, and Pip hates it! Play 5 cards befor

t: How do I play Mini kitchen?
k: Pip orders a tiny sandwich. Tap the layers in the order he asks, bread first and last. Three wobbles and it's over. He eats it, so it counts as a snack.
Open the book and tap Teach. He gets it right three times, then he knows the trick for good.
Play has sums, counting, patterns, telling the time, a numbers round, picture sudoku, coding Pip to a snack, secret codes, bridge building, paper planes and a b
Play > Toys > Board: big buttons that make silly noises, and Pip reacts to every one. There's a page just for parps. Press one too many times and he'll co
Yes! Play > Toys > 2P: put the phone down between you. Player 1 has the left button, Player 2 the right. Tug of war, a soundboard battle, or Pip says for
From 1 to 24 December there's an advent calendar in the book (Memories). Open a door each day for a little picture and a joke from Pip. Missed a day? That door
On Saturdays a cart rolls in with something special: a rare colour of something from the shop, at the usual price. Look in the shop's Cart tab. It brings someth

t: What is in the Finds tab?
k: Book > Finds keeps everything you find: the fish you caught, the dinosaur museum, minibeasts, stickers and the treasure map.
When Pip hatches, on every birthday and when he grows up, he stands by the door frame for a pencil mark. Book > Memories shows every Pip's marks side by side
Little charms that hang off the bottom of your case, in the shop under Cases. You can hang four at once. Some of them do things: try shaking the phone, or turni
Open the daily present, look after Pip, have birthdays, sleep well, and grow flowers in the window box.
A fizzy drink from the shop: +50 energy, and something silly happens!
Tap the bag. Buy hats, room things, toys, fidget toys, a keyring, special food, case colours, seeds and mystery capsules with the coins you earn in the game. It
Buy a seed in the shop. It grows in the box at the top right in 8 hours, even with the app closed. Tap the flower to pick it for coins.
A surprise hat or toy from the shop. Some hats only come from capsules! If you get one you already have, you get some coins back.
Tap the book. It keeps everything you have seen and earned: events, Pips raised, pets, shop things, achievements and titles. It lasts for every Pip.

t: Can I watch an event again?
k: Yes! Open the book and tap an event you have seen. Pip does it again, just for fun: it gives no coins.
Do things (feed 100 meals, keep a sleep streak...) to earn titles like Chef or the Tidy. Pick one for before his name and one for after in the book.

t: What do the stars on events mean?
k: In the book, every event has stars: ★ happens any time, ★★ needs the right time, weather or a pet, ★★★ only comes in one season or after something you do, ★★★★
Ice lollies are in the shop in the summer (June to August), once the Summer pack has opened. They cost 5 and make Pip happier.
It pops up when something new goes into your book.
Come back every day for a present. Days in a row make a streak, with a bigger present every 7th day.

t: How do I take a photo?
k: Tap the camera, pick a frame and a sticker, then Share.
At the top of the pets in the book: three pets you haven't met yet, with a hint about how to meet them. They change every day.
Every song Pip sings goes in the book under Records. Tap one to hear it again!
Yes! Tilt your phone and they hang down, give it a shake and they swing about. Calm mode keeps them still.
Book > Memories > Make a time capsule. Pick your favourite colour, food and animal, and Pip buries them in a tin. After 30 days he digs it up and asks if
Once a day Pip asks a silly question, like: jelly hair or spaghetti arms? Pick one and he tells you which he'd pick. All your answers are in the book (Memories)

t: Pip said Knock knock! What do I do?
k: Tap Who's there? and play along! He knows lots of jokes.

t: What is the X in the ground?
k: Now and then an X appears. Tap it again and again and Pip digs! Each X has a dinosaur bone. Five bones make a whole skeleton for the museum in the book (Finds).
Minibeasts crawl by now and then. Tap one and Pip looks at it through his magnifying glass and tells you something true about it. Then he waves it off home. Eac

t: What is the balloon with a parcel?
k: Now and then in the daytime, a balloon floats over with a parcel. Tap it before it floats away, and the parcel comes down on a parachute. What's inside? Sticker

t: What is the torn bit of paper?
k: It's a piece of a treasure map! Tap it to pick it up. Pieces turn up on different days, and missing a day doesn't matter. Find all 4 and Pip digs for treasure.
Pets love a dig! Now and then Pip's pet digs a little hole and finds something. Good find!
Little Pips talk in Pip-speak! Every new word goes in the book (Memories), with what it means. He says fewer as he grows up... but you never know.

t: Why did Pip give me a present?
k: When Pip is happy and well looked after, now and then he brings you something he found or made. Each one goes on the From Pip shelf in the book (Memories).

t: Does Pip do anything on special days?
k: Yes! Around Valentine's Day, Pancake Day, Easter, Halloween, Fireworks night, Christmas and New Year, look out for surprises, and festivals from all around the

t: What are the pipes and toasters?
k: When nobody touches the phone for a few minutes, a screensaver comes on, like old computers had: a sheep, flying toasters, growing pipes or a bouncing box. Tap

t: What are the planes in the sky?
k: Sometimes in the daytime a little plane flies over pulling a banner with a message on it. Read it as it goes past! Other planes write words in the sky with smok
Once a day Pip says hello in your phone's language. He also has a snack and visitors from your part of the world. He only looks at the phone's language and time

t: Why does Pip drink tea and say Hello ladies and gentlemen?
k: Sometimes Pip pretends to be a famous British YouTuber who loves tea and finding sneaky tricks in games. Spiffing! Once you have seen it, look in the shop.

t: What does Pip do in the snow and rain?
k: After the rain he jumps in puddles. In the snow he has snowball fights and builds snowmen. He flies kites on windy days, and more!

t: Why is there a chicken on the food bar?
k: Now and then the food bar turns into a roast chicken being eaten, just for fun. The real food bar doesn't change.
Yes! Sometimes his phone rings, he plays on a tablet, rides a robot vacuum, tries VR goggles or drives a remote control car. Watch out for autocorrect!

t: Why does nothing happen when I leave Pip alone?
k: Pip saves his adventures for when you are there to see them. After 2 minutes with no taps, a screensaver comes on and nothing new starts until you tap again.
Now and then Pip puts on his very own little opera, with a spotlight. Listen out for the big finish!

t: What are the old internet things?
k: Pip loves the internet of long ago: pop-ups, dial-up, dancing babies, hamsters and home pages "under construction". Ask a grown-up about them! Some yo
Rain, drizzle, storms, fog, hail, snow, wind, sunshine, sun showers, frosty mornings and heatwaves! Sometimes there's a raindrop race: tap the drop you think wi

t: Why does Pip say different things?
k: Pip talks like his age! A baby Pip babbles, a kid asks lots of questions (and has a grumpy teenage day), a grown-up worries about the price of bananas, and an o
In the week before Halloween Pip dresses up in a new costume every day, and spooky-silly things happen: potions, spiders, a dancing skeleton... There's apple bo
Sparklers, a bonfire, a Catherine wheel and rockets, and some bonfire treats. If Pip has a pet, he keeps it safe from the bangs.

t: Why is there a ♪ by some messages?
k: That's Pip singing! He loves a silly song about cheese or fish.

t: What do the little marks on messages mean?
k: ★ is news, ! means something is happening, a speech bubble is a fun fact or quote. Plain words are Pip talking.
Every two weeks a new pack opens all by itself, with new things for Pip to do and new pets to meet. Look in the book to see when the next one comes!

t: What happens if I shake or turn the phone?
k: Shake it and Pip gets dizzy. Tip it right over to one side and hold on to him! Try turning it other ways too...

t: Why does Pip yawn about my phone?
k: When your phone battery is low, Pip reminds you to charge it.
A little pony who never seems happy, whatever happens. Maybe one day...

t: Why is Pip waving at me?
k: With Music and Sounds both off, Pip can't hear you and you can't hear him! Now and then he waves to say hello. Turn them back on in Settings.
Yes! Sometimes he puts on a show with his very own songs from PIPSQUEAK RECORDS.
Lots! Some names are secret... try your favourite game or hero. Keep watching: all sorts of things happen when you least expect it.
Yes! A grown-up can add it in Settings > Your birthday (just the day and month). On the day, Pip wears a party hat, bakes you a cake and sings. It stays on t
Settings > Helper chart. A grown-up sets up to 3 real jobs, like brushing teeth or tidying toys. Tick each one when it's done and Pip cheers! It starts fresh

t: Why does it ask a sum before sharing?
k: Sharing a photo or a backup, and sending a line, leave the game. A grown-up answers the sum first. They only need to do it once every 5 minutes.

t: Something went wrong. How do I tell you?
k: Settings > Report a problem. A grown-up answers a sum, then you can share a short note with what Pip was doing. Write what went wrong at the end.

t: Can my brother or sister have their own Pip?
k: Yes! Settings > Players > type their name and tap Add. Each player has their own Pip, coins and book. When the game opens it asks who's playing. A grown-u
Mikeynma and his son! See Settings > About for the version number and thank-yous.
A setting for little ones. When it's on, a Pip who can't carry on goes off on a big adventure and sends a postcard, instead of passing away. The score and the T
Settings > Calm mode turns off flashing lights, shaking screens and nudges. It also turns on by itself if your phone is set to reduce motion.
Settings > Diary. Pip writes a few words about each day.
Settings > Grandma's. Pip goes to stay with Grandma while you are busy, and his needs stand still. Tap Bring home when you are back.

t: Can I play with the sound off?
k: Yes! Settings > Captions shows a little word for every sound, like [MUNCH] or [BOOM], so you never miss a joke.
A setting for parents, behind the grown-up sum: Pip says a few extra lines about tired-grown-up life, and now and then does something only a grown-up would (lik

t: Can I hide the pet or the teddy?
k: Settings > Dismiss pet sends it off for a nap (Recall brings it back). Settings > Put away teddy (or ball) puts it away, and Get out brings it back. They

t: How do I keep my Pip safe?
k: Settings > Backup makes a code you can keep. Settings also has sounds, music and buzz on or off.

t: How do I start again from scratch?
k: Settings > Backup > Start again from scratch. A grown-up does a sum, then types RESET. It deletes every player's Pip, book and everything else on this pho

t: Is Pip saved if I lose my phone?
k: If the phone's Google backup is on, Android saves the game about once a day. Install Pocket Pip on the new phone and your Pip comes back. For extra safety, Sett
